slides.lead: You can't code all day and post all day. So build a system.
Context-switching kills both the code and the content. Do it in one block.
A carousel, a tweet-style post, a quick story. Same idea, different angle.
When it's scheduled, a busy week doesn't break your streak.
A simple list of topics stops you repeating yourself.
The bug you fixed. The ad you tested. The rejection you got. Write it down.
